$Comment: Cursed Geodes in ore: while Hallow's Eve runs, breaking an ore block a player did not place turns
one up far more often than plain stone does, and it lands where the block broke. The file name is
When names BreakBlock on every block id starting Ore_. Chance is the row's own odds as a percent.
The season rides on each roll's Conditions, as in Hallows_Eve_Geode_Find.json: the first roll is
the find and carries the toast's Cue, the second adds one more geode on Harvest Moon nights. A
server owner retunes or switches off this row by its id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/bonus-rows.json.
